_about: Public-domain Karl Joseph von Hefele (1809-1893, Bishop of Rottenburg) in English for the Word Hoard: A History of the Councils of the Church, 5 vols to A.D. 787 (Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark, 1871-1896), tr. W. R. Clark and H. N. Oxenham, and the Life of Cardinal Ximenez, tr. Canon Dalton (1860), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 29 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
